name_zh: 萨尔瓦多·奥斯卡·罗梅罗：大主教解放神学与殉道内战真相
name_en: El Salvador Oscar Romero: Archbishop Liberation Theology & Martyrdom Civil War Truth
description_zh: 奥斯卡·罗梅罗 (1917-1980) 萨尔瓦多圣萨尔瓦多大主教，解放神学实践者为穷人发声，1980年弥撒中被右翼死亡小队枪杀，殉道点燃内战，2018年教皇封圣，真相委员会揭露国家犯罪。
description_en: Oscar Romero (1917-1980) El Salvador San Salvador Archbishop, liberation theology practitioner spoke for poor, 1980 assassinated during Mass by right-wing death squad, martyrdom ignited civil war, 2018 canonized by Pope, truth commission revealed state crimes.
reason_zh: 罗梅罗代表天主教会如何通过解放神学介入政治冲突，展示了殉道者如何成为内战真相与和解的道德锚点，其封圣标志教会对解放神学的历史和解。
reason_en: Romero represents how Catholic Church intervenes in political conflict through liberation theology, demonstrating how martyr becomes civil war truth and reconciliation moral anchor, his canonization marking Church historical reconciliation with liberation theology.
steps_zh: 研究罗梅罗早年神学教育与保守派大主教形象
分析1977年神父鲁蒂利奥遇害触发罗梅罗转向
探讨广播讲道谴责军政府与右翼死亡小队
评估1980年弥撒遇刺与内战全面爆发
总结大主教解放神学殉道内战真相对萨尔瓦多和平进程的道德支撑
steps_en: Study Romero early theology education and conservative Archbishop image
Analyze 1977 Father Rutilio murder triggering Romero turn
Explore radio sermons condemning military junta and right-wing death squads
Evaluate 1980 Mass assassination and civil war full outbreak
Summarize Archbishop liberation theology martyrdom civil war truth moral support for El Salvador peace process
expected_zh: 理解解放神学如何从教义转化为政治行动指南，掌握殉道者道德权威如何在内战中制约双方暴力，评估罗梅罗遗产对拉美教会政治参与的历史定位。
expected_en: Understand how liberation theology transforms from doctrine into political action guide, grasp martyr moral authority constraining both sides violence in civil war, evaluate Romero legacy historical positioning for Latin American Church political engagement.
case_zh: 1977 大主教；1980 殉道；2018 封圣；真相委员会。大主教解放神学殉道真相范式永存。
case_en: 1977 Archbishop; 1980 martyrdom; 2018 canonization; truth commission. Archbishop liberation theology martyrdom truth paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Liberation theology; martyrdom; civil war; canonization; truth commission
